checks.semantics: Collapse XML whitespace. Apply the complete pinned builtin value/lexical contract and base chain. Machine type limits and resource exhaustion are independent of normative domain validity.

expected_outcomes.pass: Known applicable condition holds (or a complete context fact is produced).
expected_outcomes.unknown: Required instance fact is unavailable though its capability exists.
expected_outcomes.unsupported: Selected adapter/operator/provider lacks a required capability.
expected_outcomes.blocked: Invalid prerequisite prevents a meaningful dependent comparison; preserve causal link.
expected_outcomes.fail: Known applicable normative predicate is false; context providers instead retain invalid evidence and cause.
expected_outcomes.not-applicable: Known antecedent false or subject outside the declared scope; missing information alone is insufficient.

checks.model_limit: Current-model facts only. Each field needs an explicit presence/branch/order/value/lexeme capability binding before implementation acceptance; no historical source pass is inferred.

model_evidence.source_lexical_clauses: Not assessable from a typed model value unless the field itself retains the corresponding string/lexeme. Mark unsupported for that historical clause, not violation or not-applicable.
model_evidence.value_space_clauses: Check the current exact value when available. Current strings are values with their own datatype contract; float64 is exact binary-model evidence, not recovered source decimal.
model_evidence.structure_clauses: Only representable current presence/branch/order/count. Pointer absence may be known; required non-pointer scalar presence history and collapsed repeated occurrences are not recoverable.
model_evidence.namespace_clauses: Current QName/declaration identity can be assessed if mapped; original bindings/prefix history cannot.
model_evidence.readiness_gate: An exact generated field/declaration capability map and target-specific fixtures are required before enabling this contract in a profile.

checks.implementation_binding: deferred_to_implementation; no provider, runtime selector compiler or Go field walker is implemented by this plan

namespace_current_names.source: Expanded-name and declaration scope before namespace filtering.
namespace_current_names.model: Current declaration/QName identity only; historical namespace bindings unavailable.

pinned_schema_context.source: Assembly/import graph from pinned local schema set.
pinned_schema_context.model: Same graph applies to current-model declaration identities; no reader needed.

current_value_no_source_lexeme.source: XML-normalized lexeme plus derived exact value and member identity.
current_value_no_source_lexeme.model: Current stored string or exact numeric value; historical lexeme/decimal/presence is separately unavailable.

current_model_structure.source: Complete ordered child/attribute facts before information loss.
current_model_structure.model: Current fields/pointers/ordered Content only after a per-field capability binding; original repetitions/order may be unavailable.

semantic_clause_capabilities.source: Each semantic subclause consumes its explicit facts and completed scope.
semantic_clause_capabilities.model: Value/structure subclauses use current evidence; lexical, namespace-history and source-presence clauses require preserved evidence or stay unsupported.

dependency_semantics.plan_dependencies: Exact structured schema and semantic references. May be recursive through element/type graphs; these are compilation edges, not a DAG evaluation schedule. Schema edges are all exact occurrence/builtin IDs inside record.parameters, resolved through the pinned occurrence map; language edges come from record.semantic_rule_ids. The external record retains each reference-site path.
dependency_semantics.dependencies: Generic operation prerequisites. Acyclic; invalid prerequisite blocks dependent comparison with a causal link. ID/IDREF also require complete document index before absence/uniqueness conclusions.
dependency_semantics.reuse_instances: Resolved clauses reused by aggregate views. Complex residual closedness/text remain local; simple-domain views add no independent failure.
